# Proposal 

## Guidance on word count

- Introduction and motivation (500-1000 words)
- Literature review and hypothesis development (2500-3500 words)
- Measurement and Methodology (750 - 1250 words)

## Some writing tips

- Explain important concepts and theories
- Theory first, then literature review
- Avoid vague and hedging words as much as possible

# Some feedback on the pitching document

## Theory = Different explanations for the same phenomenon

> More ESG disclosure because more capabilities

> More ESG disclosure because more scrutiny

> More ESG disclosure because more need for capital

## Theory = A succint summary of prior literature

> Tokenisation is a market structure change

## Theory = Relevance of your findings

> Is a short-selling ban (sometimes) good?

## Theory = What are the important variables?

> Reasons for delegation: lack of knowledge by decision makers
